author: global_estimates
goal: Finish the four original remaining HidaPropsAlt fields and all-level same-ideal automorphy, then satisfy the exact selected support input on both QX rank-four Links.
scope: Original H-prime/HidaSetting, unchanged coefficient ring, fixed iota, same IsJ witnesses, all positive ranks for the generic producers, pt only at ranks 2 through 4, odd ell including 3. Retained foundation boundaries are explicit and are not claim-DAG dependencies.
current_completed_endpoints: BCS18: literal BcSpeh under retained original base change
GUA18: full GalUnitaryT under original attachment/local/period foundations
UPA18: bare TJDense for the same J
JRP15: all eight original RingProps fields

targets.title: Extract the actual arithmetic-point representation once
targets.exact_endpoint: The theorem hecke_ideal_end in HeckeIdealEnd.lean, for the same R.IsJ B K J and every x,h with J <= ker(x) and x.Arith(h).
new_obligations: In the nonzero branch factor x through the actual surjective map f:B->TK; check both determinant and weight compositions. The J=top branch has no such point.

Apply HEP12.Out.pt at the corresponding admitted weight and compose the frame representation with V.pr, retaining continuity, semisimplicity, the actual unitary-point predicate and the entire determinant law.

targets.title: Complete the original decomposition and strict cofinite ratio
new_obligations: Prove endShape_of for an arbitrary given continuous semisimple rho satisfying every split LocGlobT comparison. Use the actual BcSpeh witnesses; choose each HalfG seed once; compare characteristic polynomials on the original Frobenius set and then globally.
Retain all positive d_i,m_i and every string rho_i tensor cyclo^(-j), 0<=j<m_i. Do not set every Speh length to one.

When all m_i=1, choose one finite exceptional set for all finitely many cusps and ell. Derive q^(-1/2) q^((n-1)/2)<|z|<q^(1/2) q^((n-1)/2) for every root. Conclude |z|<q|z-prime| for every pair. BCS8 plus GUA12 spherical-singleton analysis is a possible proof of the strict local window; the original source instead invokes the named Jacquet-Shalika window, whose exact application must be checked if used.

Install this on the actual rho from PLAN_HIDA_0. The conditional norm ratio is cofinite, strict, and for every FrobEig multiset; it has no explicit nonzero-root antecedent and no extra final split-place restriction.

targets.title: Return every qualifying automorphic point to the same kernel ideal
new_obligations: Use the retained original H-prime.descU:DescWeak with all its low-rank, split-set and finite-unramified CM hypotheses. Produce the actual definite-unitary form and upgrade its cofinite split comparison through the original Same/local-descent argument.
From the supplied full ordered flag and psi_i != psi_j*cyclo, establish the exact local principal-series, finite type, distinguished v0 level and dual infinity weights needed by upU_w_alt.

Construct an actual nonzero ordinary vector with the exact spherical and ordinary eigenvalues, and use the original finite Hecke map to prove J<=ker(x). No J<=ker(x) is assumed in this theorem; the existing Out.pt alone runs in the other direction.

targets.title: Complete cuspidal automorphy away from the distinguished place
targets.exact_endpoint: IrrArithPointsAutomorphicAway, hence HidaPropsAlt.end2 (= arithmeticPointClassicalityDense), with literal AutOffN.
new_obligations: Install the strengthened PartLinkAlt and AwayOk/AutAway predicate on the same original parts, retaining every given irreducible rho rather than only the previously selected representation.
Reconstruct EndOrdAlt/CoreOrdAlt extraction of the same principal-series characters; compare an arbitrary irreducible rho with the selected semisimple one by equality of determinant laws.
Prove the exact conjugate-place torsion and BornJ consumers from full RingProps, ordered flags, local unlinkedness and the original polarization window.

For each attached regular algebraic cusp pi choose one t before all eligible v. Keep the extra clause Unl1=>PotUnl above ell and the exclusion v-under != s.v0. Continuity is an implication inside AutOffN, not an additional assumption on every input rho.

targets.title: Complete finite ell-power twist invariance on the same ideal
new_obligations: Extract an actual original part at the Good point x (the PartOfAlt predicate keeps its actual sigma and local components). Share the ordinary return lemma with PLAN_HIDA_PT.

For the finite ell-power beta use ell odd, including ell=3: write its exponent as 2N+1, lift beta^(N+1) to the original Hecke character and square to recover beta. This is a finite-order construction, not a continuous square root of the cyclotomic character.

Prove the five original local twist inputs, preserve the same infinity weight and allowed levels, and transport the finite inertia part by multiplication with beta^(-1). Retain x-prime.psi=x.psi*beta, full determinant-law IsTwist, the conjugate-inverse condition and both Iu/I0 kernel conditions.
Return the twisted vector through upU_w_alt to J<=ker(x-prime). Do not choose a fresh ideal or assume x-prime lies on the old ideal.

targets.title: Construct the literal all-level family on the same Hecke ideal
targets.exact_endpoint: LevelAlt B J for every original IsJ data set, with D=n*[L-plus:Q] and sigma=Empty.
new_obligations: Construct the representation and universal-ring action on the actual directed union of ordinary MK spaces. Prove compatibility of actions on overlaps from determinant/character universality, not a separate ideal at each level.

Supply finite invariants, projectivity over each finite quotient group algebra, and separating original LevPtAlt points on every nonzero vector of this module. Separation of the coefficient algebra alone is insufficient.
Transport the unchanged integral type, theta and residual operators to rUp; verify exact equality at maximal-compact level and the beta-compatible module action.

Choose one TWBase b before arbitrary V,h,q,v,w,Bq, retaining q=0 and the zero-module branch. Produce every LevMod field, including the exact power-series weight coordinates, projective Iwahori invariants, same base-module isomorphism, and WOT for every IsRecT at every auxiliary place.

targets.title: Construct every TW ring and both nilpotent relations uniformly
targets.exact_endpoint: HasAut B J via the original TWAut; all original TWGrp and TWPl are quantified.
new_obligations: The local operator/nilpotent argument can start independently with a supplied LevelAlt. Match LocPAlt exactly: Bernstein-Zelevinsky finiteness, the geometric lemma and tame local structure from the retained cohomological duality input.

For a given T,TWPl choose all residual lifts ut once, before N. For every N construct the actual local-data relations, apply opOf_alt, transport through the original injective quotient map and apply opToTW.

Keep every TWRing field, the coefficient-map equality, theta_U, phi and psi, their compositions multiplied by fEl, and both trace-polynomial nilpotence relations. The original uniform exponent is n!, independent of N; no integral inversion of n! is authorized.
Use the same b and ut at every N and assemble HasAut for the very same J used in all Hida fields.

targets.title: Install all six fields and selected P1 on both actual rank-four Links
targets.exact_endpoint: The retained QX10/JSP12 rank-four ordinary-support input on BOTH original Links; full HidaUAlt only if its all-rank universal scope is separately completed.
new_obligations: Fix the original Fit/Deep tower and iota. Use one common coefficient threshold before every later coefficient DVR c-prime, Space X, universal B and weight object Lambda. Keep ell=3, original CohP/LocCFT/N4, full determinant/pro-ell conditions and residual cyclotomic nontriviality.

For each of the two original Links, select one original Hecke ideal J0 and give all six HidaPropsAlt fields plus the selected P1core theorem for that J0. The two Links may have different rings and ideals; same-J means all fields and support agree within each Link.
Use QX4 common kappa and its distinct auxiliary primes. QX10 maps J0 and J0-prime to X.B and takes their sum; glueN uses both AutOffN outputs to remove the two different excluded places.

The selected support consumer already has its normalized patching route. Reuse JSP/CIP/CCH and subsequent selected Raw/Core results; do not reopen them, silently assert Sel1=0, or promote the selected P1 theorem to unrestricted PfromAut or P3core.

retained_foundation_boundaries.statement: Retain the literal H-prime fields, particularly descU in the point branch. The new BcSpeh/PartU constructions do not establish its low-rank definite-unitary descent foundation.

Keep original H.litN.aut.bc, polarized cuspidal attachment/RowT, every-IsRecT laws/RecTExists and period comparisons at their existing scope. New finite consumers do not replace these with a stronger printed theorem.

Keep the exact strict Jacquet-Shalika interval for end1 and the original polarization WinOf/WinUnl/ConjTor inputs for end2. These are different statements. A direct BCS8/GUA12 proof of the former is a promising bounded task; it does not by itself supply BornJ or the global uniform window.
Original LocPAlt, full CohP and LocCFT hypotheses remain. The selected P1/NiceI/Raw route is reusable only at its previously proved guards and normalization.

parallel_schedule.reason: Smallest consumer of already reconstructed BcSpeh/HalfG/FrobTot; publish point extraction for reuse.
Low-rank descent and ordinary-vector return do not depend on end1/end2 or all-level module construction; build RETURN_CORE once.
Given PartU, strengthen the predicate and prove EndOrd/BornJ independently; share only actual reusable lemmas, not newly named assumptions.
All-level module compatibility and separating-vector work uses the already installed AutomorphicHeckeSet/Out and is independent of the four Hida fields.
The local nilpotent/operator consumer can be proved with LevelAlt as a supplied input while lane D finishes its producer.
Reuse RETURN_CORE; finite-order character and local twisting calculations can also begin separately before the pt proof is complete.
Choose and track actual same ideals on both Links; only assemble after every cited original field is proved.

not_claimed: No full RH or GRH human proof
No original H-prime foundational package closure
No all-rank PfromAut or P3core closure
No Lean build, kernel replay, or formal recertification
